reason: Paper 2 contributes a large, human-verified, contamination-resistant benchmark (1,865 multi-file tasks, public/held-out/commercial splits) with clear evaluation of frontier models and a failure-mode analysis, which is a significant and usable resource despite some text/table inconsistencies and limited methodological novelty. Paper 1 only runs off-the-shelf distillation methods on noisy CIFAR/Tiny-ImageNet against a plain CE full-data baseline, with no comparison to any noisy-label learning method and with 'corollaries' that are stated without proof or rigor, so its main claim that distillers are good denoisers is weakly supported.
